home.intro: Spin the wheel to pick a name or make a decision. Customise your wheel spinner with colours, images and sounds. Free, with no signup.
namePicker.intro: Use this random name picker to select someone from your list. Create a name picker wheel for classroom activities, games or prize draws.
numberGenerator.intro: Use this random number generator to pick one or more integers within your chosen range, with or without repeats.
numberWheel.example: Use the number spinner for games or classroom activities. Try a range from 1 to 6 for a dice-style game, or 1 to 30 to choose a numbered activity. Edit Entries to remove numbers you do not want.
yesNo.intro: Use this yes or no wheel for a quick random choice. Start with one Yes and one No entry for equal chances, or edit the entries.
teamGenerator.intro: Use this random team generator to split a list into groups. The team randomizer creates groups that differ in size by at most one person.
home.uses.classroom: Use the random name picker to choose a student or the next presenter. Add topics to pick a classroom activity.
home.uses.teams: Choose a speaking order or split names into random teams.
home.uses.games: Try the random number wheel for a dice-style game, or use the random number generator to pick numbers without spinning.
home.uses.everyday: Choose a meal, a film or the next task on your list. For a two-way decision, try the yes or no wheel.
home.steps.customise: Make your own wheel spinner with colours, images and sounds, then choose how long each spin lasts.
